LightningComponentBundle.description: Generates or improves a Portfolio Item's Description or Resume Details using the Salesforce Models API, then saves it back to the record.

property.name: modelName
property.label: Default AI model
property.description: API name of the Salesforce-managed model used for AI generation (e.g. sfdc_ai__DefaultOpenAIGPT4OmniMini). Can also be changed at runtime in the editor.
